identity.name: Sam Hains
identity.current_position: Associate Lecturer in Digital Design, RMIT School of Design

childhood.family_role: The 'calm and sensible' one, defined in opposition to Harry's 'precocious weirdness'
childhood.early_identity: Stable, sensible, ordinary, conformist - in contrast to Harry who was weird, difficult, volatile
childhood.shared_experiences: Created imaginary worlds with Harry, played video games, explored alternate universes together

transformation.career_shift: Quit job as software engineer to pursue career in the arts
transformation.reconciliation: As adults, differences with Harry became 'smaller and more cosmetic'
transformation.growing_connection: Interests and passions grew closer together - virtual worlds, avatars, simulations, science fiction
transformation.shared_bond: Discovered shared weirdness, sense of humor, enthusiasm, passion, creative drive and spirit
transformation.unrealized_collaboration: Spoke of future collaboration but held back waiting for Harry's sobriety

masters.institution: Tisch School of the Arts, NYU - Interactive Telecommunications Program (ITP)
masters.description: Known as 'the Center for the Recently Possible' - commitment to experimental media

artistic_focus.medium: 3D art, animation, VFX, generative art, real-time engines, AI pipelines
themes: Glitching realities and dream worlds falling apart
Critical examination of digital tools and modernity
Liberation from the mundane and oppressive
artistic_focus.philosophy: Bringing fantasy into the everyday, DIY realities, computers as 'reality-construction kits'

antiboy.description: 3D worldbuilding for ANTIBOY project, inspired by Harry's unreleased TV pilot 'A Glitch In Paradise'
antiboy.work: Created animations and CGI for music videos 'Paradise', 'Bang Bang', and 'Dream'
antiboy.concept: Cyborg performers existing in multiple worlds and realities, layering augmented and hyper realities
antiboy.emotional_significance: Working with Harry's material, channeling him, feeling his presence

bullet_heaven.description: Series of generative 'bullet paintings' inspired by Danmaku arcade games
bullet_heaven.achievement: Bullet Heaven [YOKO] won Optimism Grand Prize for Generative Art (largest NFT art prize)
bullet_heaven.exhibition: Bullet Heaven [ULTIMATE] shown at Galerie Yeche Lange, New York

lost_home_worlds.description: Series of procedurally generated castles inside bottles

date_me.description: Designed live, networked projection system for Off-Broadway improv play
date_me.innovation: Allowed actors and audiences to co-create content in real-time

teaching.current_role: Associate Lecturer (Education-Focused) in Digital Media and MAGI at RMIT

signature_course.name: Simulations & World-Building
signature_course.satisfaction: Average 4.5/5 CES satisfaction score (>50% response rate)
signature_course.philosophy: Positions computers as 'reality-construction kits' to foster critically engaged thinking about synthetic worlds

pedagogical_approach.goal: Equip students to reimagine tools, not merely operate them
pedagogical_approach.innovation: Exploring creative applications of cutting-edge technology while interrogating cultural, ethical, and aesthetic stakes

research_interests: Role of creativity and artistry in machinic ecosystems

childhood_dynamics.harry_land: Harry created elaborate imaginary world at age 7-8, accessible through wardrobe with DIY sound effects
childhood_dynamics.contrast: Sam identified himself in opposition to Harry's weirdness throughout childhood
childhood_dynamics.public_perception: Constantly told they were 'completely different', with Sam as calm/sensible and Harry as weird/volatile
childhood_dynamics.challenge: Harry was 'very unusual, creative, challenging' - pushed boundaries, frightened parents, made people uncomfortable

shared_passions.gaming: Bonded over video games and escapism in alternate universes
shared_passions.conceptual_overlap: Both worked with virtual worlds, avatars, simulations, science fiction
shared_passions.creative_collaboration: Amazing to jam with Harry - he would inhabit ideas and build worlds from them
shared_passions.formal_world_building: Both loved anime, video games, sci-fi - mediums involving world-building

adult_relationship.convergence: Interests and passions grew closer after Sam joined the arts
adult_relationship.connection: Shared special connection - weirdness, humor, enthusiasm, passion, creative drive
adult_relationship.unconscious_collaboration: Working with similar concepts without explicit discussion
adult_relationship.limitation: Sam held off on collaboration hoping for Harry's sobriety

grief_and_processing.transformation: Can now see Harry without anger or fear that once clouded vision
grief_and_processing.recognition: Sees Harry in 'tye-died, Technicolor glory' - his full, brilliant, unique vision
grief_and_processing.self_discovery: Able to identify how much of Harry exists within himself
grief_and_processing.continuation: Taking what was powerful and magical about Harry forward, carrying it within
grief_and_processing.channeling: When working with Harry's material, enters 'strange trance state' and feels like channeling him
grief_and_processing.presence: Strong sense that Harry is still with him, perhaps 'running the simulation OS now'
grief_and_processing.unconscious_influence: People say 'there is so much Harry' in Sam's work - happening unconsciously

harrys_legacy.inspiration: ANTIBOY concept inspired by Harry's work, particularly 'A Glitch In Paradise' pilot
harrys_legacy.qualities: Boldness, creativity, fearlessness, lack of shame, genius
harrys_legacy.impact: Bright star who inspired and left greater impact than most in full lifetime
harrys_legacy.courage: Incredibly courageous about who he was
harrys_legacy.suffering: Suffered from trying to fit into world that reduces things to simplistic labels
harrys_legacy.message: His art should inspire people to be brave and unapologetic about who they are

existential_perspective.alienation: Feels existentially alienated, similar to Harry
existential_perspective.conviction: Innate conviction that something is false or broken about 'reality'
existential_perspective.glitching_reality: Experiences reality as a 'glitching dream world'
existential_perspective.seams_visible: Interested in moments when world falls apart and you can see behind the curtain

artistic_philosophy.imagination_power: Fascinated with power of imagination to create worlds
artistic_philosophy.diy_realities: Creating DIY realities through art and technology
artistic_philosophy.re_enchantment: Bringing fantasy into everyday to re-enchant world
artistic_philosophy.liberation: Using imagination to liberate from mundane and oppressive
artistic_philosophy.cyborg_humanity: Humans are already cyborgs in digital world, existing in multiple realities

values: Holding space for people who are different
Being brave and unapologetic about identity
Accepting and loving those who don't fit conventional molds

creative_process.approach: Trusts the process, doesn't control what ideas emerge
creative_process.unconscious_work: Ideas happen unconsciously, especially when working with Harry's material
creative_process.connection: Feels deeply connected to Harry as brothers, influences bleed through naturally
creative_process.magic_emergence: Returns from trance-like work states to find 'new magic' has appeared
creative_process.technical_creative_fusion: Bridges advanced technical knowledge with creative thinking

context_for_ai.purpose: This profile helps AI understand Sam when exploring scenarios related to his brother Harry's death
key_themes: Working through trauma via creative practice
The power of imagination and world-building as healing

emotional_landscape.past: Anger, fear, frustration with Harry's behavior
emotional_landscape.ongoing: Processing grief through art, feeling Harry's continued presence, carrying his spirit forward

therapeutic_elements.art_as_processing: Uses artistic practice to process grief and maintain connection
therapeutic_elements.channeling_experience: Enters altered states when working with Harry's material
therapeutic_elements.continuing_bond: Maintains relationship with Harry through creative work
therapeutic_elements.identity_integration: Recognizing and embracing Harry's qualities within himself
therapeutic_elements.meaning_making: Creating meaning from loss through continuation of shared vision
